name: Whisper Lyrics Sync
author: Vibo
description: Gives tracks synced lyrics by listening to them with Whisper: times a song's plain lyrics, re-times synced ones that are off, or transcribes what it hears (talks, videos, songs without lyrics). You check every result in the lyrics editor before it's saved. Local files only.

permissionReasons.playback:read: Notice when a song starts, for automatic syncing (off until you turn it on)
permissionReasons.plugins:call: Read the song's current lyrics through your lyrics providers
permissionReasons.library:read: Find the song's file in your library
permissionReasons.lyrics:write: Save the timed lyrics, or a transcript you asked for
permissionReasons.exec:ffmpeg: Read the track's audio for Whisper
permissionReasons.exec:whisper-cli: Listen to the track: time the words, or transcribe them when you ask
permissionReasons.programs:run: Download the Whisper model (asked once, when you download it)
permissionReasons.network:github.com: Download the Whisper model from github.com
permissionReasons.network:release-assets.githubusercontent: GitHub's download server for the model

binaryDependencies.name: whisper-cli
binaryDependencies.reason: Listen to tracks to time their lyrics or transcribe them

definition.description: whisper.cpp speech recognition, built for Vibo

assistant.instructions: Two jobs, both with whisper.cpp on local library files only; use them instead of transcribing audio yourself. sync_lyrics times a song's existing plain lyrics from its audio and saves them as synced lyrics; it never writes lyrics a song doesn't have, and saves only when at least 70% of lines matched what was sung — otherwise it reports low-confidence and saves nothing. transcribe writes what Whisper hears in a track that has no lyrics at all (a video, a talk, an interview) as a DRAFT the user reviews and saves in the app (status draft); it saves nothing itself and never touches lyrics a track already has. Use transcribe only when the user asks for a transcript or subtitles, and tell them the draft waits in Whisper's settings under Ready to review. A long video takes minutes.

tools.name: sync_lyrics
tools.description: Time a library song's plain lyrics from its audio and save them as synced lyrics. Takes tens of seconds per song. Returns status saved / low-confidence / skipped / failed with a reason.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a library track that has no lyrics (a video, a talk) from its audio, as a draft of synced lyrics (a video's subtitles) for the user to review and save in the app. Only when the user asked for a transcript or subtitles. Takes about as long as Whisper needs for the whole file (minutes for a long video). Returns status draft / skipped / failed with a reason; draft means nothing is saved until the user approves it.
